test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that completes the sentence using the correct spelling.

I _______ some great change in her attitude.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**perceived**".
 
• The word "**perceived**" means to become aware of something or interpret it in a particular way.
 
• The other options, "**percieved**", "**preceived**", and "**precieved**", are incorrect spellings.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I perceived__ some great change in her attitude.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Perceived:** The correct spelling of the word and its meaning is "to become aware or interpret something".
 
• **Other spellings:** The options like "**percieved**", "**preceived**", and "**precieved**" are incorrect.
